title: Is your Tech Sabotaging Business? Four Critical Digital Commerce Challenges Impacting your Business (And How to Fix Them)

hero.title: Is your Tech Sabotaging Business? Four Critical Digital Commerce Challenges Impacting your Business (And How to Fix Them)
hero.summary: Four critical digital commerce bottlenecks—from sluggish load times to fragmented data—and the architectural remedies to fix them.

data.heading: Slow loading times hurt conversions: Is Your Site Too Slow?
data.description: Today’s online shoppers are notoriously impatient. If your site takes even a second too long to load, you can lose customers before they see your offer.

blocks.title: Image Tricks
blocks.body: Smaller image files mean faster loading, but visual quality still matters. Use modern image formats and optimized assets.

blocks.title: CDNs to the Rescue
blocks.body: Content Delivery Networks distribute assets closer to customers so pages load faster wherever they are.

blocks.title: The Power of PWAs
blocks.body: Progressive Web Apps can make mobile experiences feel faster and more app-like.

blocks.title: Getting More Technical
blocks.body: For deeper performance issues, review asynchronous loading, network requests, caching and other delivery bottlenecks.

data.heading: Checkout Friction = Lost Sales. How Smooth is Yours?
data.description: Intricate checkout journeys drive potential customers away. Customers are increasingly impatient when it comes to payment and security friction.

blocks.title: Streamlined Flow
blocks.body: Minimize form fields, offer guest checkout options and remove unnecessary steps.

blocks.title: PCI-Compliant Gateway
blocks.body: Integrate a trusted payment gateway with seamless UX and strong compliance.

blocks.title: Security That Doesn't Slow Things Down
blocks.body: Protect customer data while keeping authentication and fraud prevention unobtrusive.

blocks.title: Tokenization & Risk Scoring Systems
blocks.body: Enhance security without adding customer friction.

data.heading: Inability to Tap Into New-age Channels for Customer Engagement Stifle Growth. Meet Customers Where They Are: Expand Your Reach

blocks.title: Seamless is the Goal
blocks.body: Customers should feel a natural extension of your main store across every engagement channel.

blocks.title: Chatbots Are Your 24/7 Sales Assistants
blocks.body: Answer questions, offer recommendations and guide customers through conversational commerce.

blocks.title: AR Gets Personal
blocks.body: Let customers experience products in their own space and increase engagement in commerce experiences.

data.heading: Data: The Key to Smarter Growth
data.description: Data should be the intelligence behind your tools.

blocks.title: All Your Data in One Place
blocks.body: Bring customer, product, sales and channel data together to reveal patterns and improve decision making.

blocks.title: Predict the Future (Well, Customer Behavior!)
blocks.body: Use predictive analytics to anticipate what customers may do next.

blocks.title: Make Every Experience Personal
blocks.body: Use customer context and behavior to tailor experiences and recommendations.

blocks.title: Test, Tweak, Repeat
blocks.body: Continuously experiment, measure outcomes and improve digital experiences.
